scripts.check: vp check vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json
scripts.check:all: vp run --cache --filter './apps/*' --filter './packages/*' --filter './tools/*' check && vp run --cache -w check && vp run --cache desktop#typecheck
scripts.ready: vp run check:all && vp run test && vp run build
scripts.ready:native: vp run ready && vp run lint:native && vp run test:native
scripts.license:gate: pnpm licenses list -r --prod --json > .licenses.json && vp run license:check && vp exec pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --json-input-file .licenses.json --output-file THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt
